PLANNING

New
Planning design mockupClick to enlarge ↗
PO: Sabrina
Team: Sabrina, Constantin, Aash

Context

Prism suggests changes to learning objectives and module descriptions. The MV reviews, edits and finalizes the proposed changes to define the foundation for Revision.

In scope

  • ✓Build the frontend page to review, edit and store the final planning version.
  • ✓Mock planning data in MongoDB.
  • ✓Demonstrate the handoff into Revision.

Assumptions / Mocked

  • ⚙Prism recommendations are mocked; the full Prism integration is not required for the demo.

Stretch

  • ★Optional webhook to send finalized planning data back to Prism.

REVISION

Improved
Revision design mockupClick to enlarge ↗
PO: Sabrina
Team: Sabrina, Eugene, Alex

Context

Incorporate Prism recommendations throughout the course script, improve the UX for working with suggestions and harden underlying XML handling.

In scope

  • ✓Mock ingestion of new course data and display recommended changes.
  • ✓Improve UI/UX for navigating, reviewing and applying suggestions.
  • ✓Harden XML handling.

Assumptions / Mocked

  • ⚙Simulate new course data ingestion; build on the existing Revision workflow.

Out of scope

  • −Implementation of an AI chat assistant.

VIDEO

New
Video design mockupClick to enlarge ↗
PO: Vanessa
Team: Vanessa, Parmida, Cag

Context

When the book or course script changes, affected unit videos and video-script sections should surface in CCH, giving MVs cues for what to adapt.

In scope

  • ✓Flag videos potentially affected by book changes.
  • ✓Display affected videos in CCH.
  • ✓Identify relevant parts of video scripts.

Assumptions / Boundaries

  • ⚙Focus on surfacing impacts, not editing videos. Demonstrate propagation using integration or mocks as needed.

Out of scope

  • −AI-generated cycle-level edit suggestions.
  • −Automated video adaptation and production.
FLEXIBLE SUPPORT: Ethan, Gu, HannaPotential support for UX/UI in Revision and alternative KPI / dashboard-related workstreams, depending on capacity and priorities.
End-to-end demonstrator: Prism suggestions → MV planning decisions → content revisions → formal / KFK / compliance reviews → publish → video impact identification
Hackathon goal: a demonstrable connected experience; production integrations and advanced AI capabilities may remain out of scope.
